assets.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: chibi game UI component reference board. A distinct CHIBI FANTASY style for Arena UI. Warm cream #fff7e7, cocoa #654c3f outlines, honey gold #ffc857 for action and rewards, sky cyan #60c9e8 for selection and energy, coral #ed777b only for health or danger, mint #7ecf9e only for healing, lavender #ab8ee6 only for epic rarity. Charming compact two-head-tall adventurers when a character is needed. Rounded chunky forms, soft hand-painted toy-like 3D depth, broad clean highlights, matte materials, friendly expressive silhouettes, clear readable small shapes. No gritty dark metal, photorealism, sharp gothic spikes or realistic adult proportions. This is its own coherent visual collection; do not mix styles. Create a front-facing 1536x1024 landscape specimen board on a clean warm cream background with an aligned modular grid and comfortable spacing. Top title exactly 'ARENA CHIBI', subtitle 'UI COLLECTION'. Include rounded plump honey-gold primary button labeled 'PLAY', cream secondary button 'EQUIP', coral outlined button 'REMOVE'; three simple capsule progress bars labeled 'HP', 'MP', 'XP'; one small rounded hero card showing a cute two-head-tall knight with short silver toy armor, a cyan scarf and large friendly eyes; eight rounded inventory slots with sword, shield, potion, boots, coin, crystal, scroll, key; a rounded confirmation modal titled 'READY?' with 'GO' and 'CANCEL'; three rounded tabs 'HERO', 'BAG', 'QUEST'; compact checkbox and on/off toggle examples. Cyan outlines for selected controls, coral HP, cyan MP, gold XP. Keep type sparse, crisp and readable. No device frame, desk, watermark, realistic battle scene or extra paragraphs. This image is a design reference, not a functioning app.

assets.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: portrait mobile lobby reference for a competitive character-progression game. A distinct CHIBI FANTASY style for Arena UI. Warm cream #fff7e7, cocoa #654c3f outlines, honey gold #ffc857 for action and rewards, sky cyan #60c9e8 for selection and energy, coral #ed777b only for health or danger, mint #7ecf9e only for healing, lavender #ab8ee6 only for epic rarity. Charming compact two-head-tall adventurers when a character is needed. Rounded chunky forms, soft hand-painted toy-like 3D depth, broad clean highlights, matte materials, friendly expressive silhouettes, clear readable small shapes. Create a finished front-facing 1024x1536 portrait mobile game home screen, full canvas with no phone frame. Top safe area with small rounded player avatar and short name 'MILO', two simple gold coin and cyan energy counters '1200' and '80'. Center a cheerful two-head-tall knight, big friendly eyes, short silver toy armor, cyan scarf, tiny rounded sword pointing safely downward, standing in a charming pastel fantasy village courtyard. Treat as UI concept art, not as interactive software.

Create one landscape 1536x1024 PNG on genuine transparent alpha, EXACTLY 4 columns by 2 rows of equal invisible cells, no labels, no text, no gutters, no drawn grid. Every isolated icon fully contained inside the central 60 percent of its cell, with generous 20 percent clear space on all sides, consistent visual weight, soft upper-left lighting. Row one left to right: friendly empty rounded knight helmet with cyan scarf for heroes; plump tan canvas backpack with honey-gold buckle for bag; blank cream scroll with honey seal for quests; tiny cream and honey striped shop awning with a wooden counter for shop. Row two left to right: rounded cream envelope with honey seal for mail; two friendly simple round-headed toy busts of different heights grouped together for friends; small honey-gold trophy with two rounded handles for ranking; one rounded cocoa and cream eight-tooth gear for settings. Compact simplified objects, no character body or human skin. No square background, checkerboard, floor, cast ground shadows, pedestal, sparkle cloud, glow, watermark or extra objects. Preserve clear separation for later manual extraction.

observations: 可见：奶油底、可可描边、圆润金色主按钮、大头小身剑士、八格道具和状态条，标题及PLAY/EQUIP/REMOVE/READY?/GO/CANCEL可读。布局完整未见画布裁切。
可见偏差：局部高光较强而非完全哑光；卷轴红色系带等装饰不完全符合红色仅健康或危险的约束。
主观判断：Q版方向与原深色金属系列明显可区分，可作为界面设计参考；这是静态图，不是已实现的组件主题。
首次Q版参考板样本，不与旧深色固定题目推断模型质量变化。
可见：竖屏大厅、全身白发剑士、青色围巾、下垂短剑、左右功能入口和底部BATTLE/HOME/HERO/BAG/GUILD完整，MILO/1200/80清楚。
可见偏差：村落细节较多，商店棚、邮件封印、日历等红色装饰和好友图标绿色衣服偏离颜色语义。
主观判断：构图适合手机大厅的参考，大头小身与圆润控件符合Q版；原图不能直接替代可交互小程序页面。
首次Q版大厅样本；生成随机性与风格改写不能当作模型升级证据。
可见：英雄头盔、背包、任务卷轴、商店、邮件、好友、奖杯、设置共8项，按4列2行排布，无文字。
透明验证：RGBA，alpha范围0–254，完全透明像素57.7432%；浅色棋盘预览可见真实透明背景。
可见偏差：头盔和信封略跨384px列分界；图标大小与边距不一致，20%安全留白未达到；好友含装饰性珊瑚红。整张边缘未切掉主体，但等宽切片会裁断前述图标。
复用限制：需按轮廓逐项裁切再检查目标尺寸；本次保留原始图集，未宣称可直接等格切片。
可见：金色主按钮、奶油次按钮、青色进度条外壳、道具槽、金色头像环、空白对话面板共6项，3列2行，无文字，无画布裁切。
透明验证：RGBA，alpha范围0–254，完全透明像素62.4791%；圆环中心坐标(768,750)的alpha为0。
可见偏差：控件占格较大、每侧20%留白未达到；进度条内含浅青填色，未分离为独立动态填充；对话面板标题条比例较浅。
复用限制：作为控件美术源图仍需切片、拉伸边界与状态设计；未实现九宫格缩放、按压或禁用态。

notes: 用户明确请求继续生成Q版UI并与旧风格分开分类，本次手动追加4张。
新系列使用chibi-fantasy标识、独立运行目录和chibi-文件名前缀。冻结对照提示词和已归档图片保持原样。
